newsitem.title: USA: N. Amer. Vaccine gets Swedish pertussis ok.
newsitem.headline: N. Amer. Vaccine gets Swedish pertussis ok.

text.p: North American Vaccine said Monday that the Medical Products Agency of Sweden granted regulatory approval to its monovalent acellular pertussis vaccine to vaccinate children against pertussis, or whooping cough.

This approval expands the indication in Sweden for the company's acellular pertussis vaccine to children who have been previously vaccinated against diphtheria and tetanus but who are still at risk for pertussis.
The complete vaccination series consists of three doses of vaccine separated by two-to-six month intervals.
In 1996, the company's combined diphtheria, tetanus and acellular pertussis vaccine was approved for routine administration in infants in Sweden.
